name: Student U (Durham)
what_you_do: Year-round support for students who would be the first in their family to go to college. You get after-school and summer programs and tutoring. You also get college advice, leadership building and career exploration. It runs from 6th grade through college.
who_can_apply: Durham County students who attend Durham Public Schools. Priority goes to students who would be the first in their family to graduate college (parents have not earned a Bachelor's degree) and/or qualify for free or reduced lunch. Students should be at or slightly below grade level and have strong family support. Rising 6th through 11th graders can apply. A lottery picks who gets in.
deadline_text: Applications opened October 20, 2026 and are due February 1, 2027. Information session in December. Lottery on February 12, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online or drop a paper form at the W.G. Pearson Center, 1200 Spaulding Street, with the latest report card, End of Grade scores, a teacher recommendation and any IEP or 504 plan. Chosen by lottery.
notes: A lottery picks about 75 rising 6th graders and fills open spots in grades 6 to 11. The page does not state the cost to families.
